title: Physics-Guided Flow-Map Matching for Precipitation Nowcasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.37487v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Precipitation nowcasting, generating future radar fields from past observations, is critical for flood warning and disaster response. It is also a demanding benchmark for spatiotemporal generative modeling, with chaotic dynamics, heavy-tailed intensities, and rare high-intensity structures that matter most. Deterministic models minimize a pixel loss and are driven toward the conditional mean, which blurs exactly those structures, while generative models that add a stochastic residual on top of a deterministic backbone inherit the same blur. We propose Physics-Guided Flow-Map Matching (PG-FMM), a conditional flow-map model that decouples predictable advection from uncertain small-scale detail. translated_title: 物理引导的流图匹配用于降水临近预报
translated_abstract: 降水临近预报，即根据过去的观测生成未来的雷达场，对洪水预警和灾害响应至关重要。它同时也是时空生成建模的一个严苛基准测试，具有混沌动力学、重尾强度分布以及最为关键的稀有高强度结构。确定性模型通过最小化像素损失被驱向条件均值，这恰恰模糊了那些高强度结构，而在确定性骨干之上叠加随机残差的生成模型同样继承了这种模糊性。我们提出了物理引导的流图匹配（PG-FMM），这是一种条件流图模型，将可预测的平流与不确定的小尺度细节解耦。一个冻结的拉格朗日平流先验传输雷达场并提供显式的运动预报，而一个流图生成头以过去的帧和先验的滚动预测为条件（而非叠加其上），产生清晰的随机细节……
tldr: 提出物理引导的流图匹配（PG-FMM），利用冻结的拉格朗日平流先验将可预测的平流运动与不确定的小尺度细节解耦，使降水临近预报能够生成清晰锐利的高强度结构而非模糊的条件均值。
en_tdlr: Proposes Physics-Guided Flow-Map Matching (PG-FMM), a conditional flow-map model that decouples predictable advection from uncertain small-scale detail using a frozen Lagrangian advection prior, enabling precipitation nowcasting to produce sharp high-intensity structures instead of blurred conditional means.
